choice.basis: The May bar is the only one visually below the 10,000 m³ mark, indicating a release volume less than 10,000 m³. This makes it clearly the lowest release volume among all displayed months. Since the chart does not provide an explicit critical threshold or anomaly policy, the convention of treating extreme low values as critical anomalies is a reasonable default for routing decisions in the absence of policy.
choice.option_label: Escalate May to critical low-release anomaly review
